cards.summary: A long task blocks the main thread

prompt.text: A piece of work over 50 milliseconds on the main thread is called what?

cards.fullLine: A piece of work over 50 milliseconds on the main thread is a long task.

teaching.text: The browser can only paint after the current piece of work finishes.

answer.text: LCP stands for Largest Contentful Paint.

hints: The final word is what a browser does to pixels.
cards.fullLine: LCP stands for Largest Contentful Paint.

teaching.text: It measures when the biggest visible block has finished arriving.

prompt.text: A tap that responds within how many milliseconds still feels immediate?

hints: Far less than a second, but more than a blink.
cards.fullLine: A tap that responds within 200 ms still feels immediate.

teaching.text: A response under a tenth of a second feels instant, and this budget is the published outer limit.

teaching.alt: A timeline with one long block delaying several short paint marks

teaching.search: Core Web Vitals Explained LCP INP CLS
teaching.alt: What Core Web Vitals measure and why they matter

prompt.text: Content that jumps after the first paint is called a layout

answer.text: Content that jumps after the first paint is called a layout shift.

hints: The page moves under the reader.
cards.fullLine: Content that jumps after the first paint is called a layout shift.

teaching.text: Content that moves after the first paint costs reading effort.

prompt.text: Which attribute tells the browser an image matters early?

hints: It combines fetching with a word for rank.
cards.fullLine: The fetchpriority attribute tells the browser an image matters early.

teaching.text: It is a hint, not a guarantee, and the server still decides.

prompt.text: Which change most likely improves LCP?

hints: The largest block has to arrive before the metric stops.
cards.fullLine: Serving a smaller hero image most likely improves LCP.

cards.summary: A blocking script stops the parser

prompt.text: A blocking script stops the HTML

answer.text: A blocking script stops the HTML parser.

hints: It is the step that reads the tags.
cards.fullLine: A blocking script stops the HTML parser.

teaching.text: The rest of the HTML waits while the script runs.

cards.summary: A flame chart shows time by call

prompt.text: On a performance recording, what does the flame chart show?

hints: Wide bars own more of the recording.
cards.fullLine: A flame chart shows where time went, by call.

cards.summary: A worker runs off the main thread

prompt.text: runs script off the main thread.

answer.text: A Web Worker runs script off the main thread.

hints: It is the browser's background helper.
cards.fullLine: A Web Worker runs script off the main thread.

teaching.text: It has its own thread and no direct access to the page's elements.

prompt.text: An image with no width or height causes what?

hints: The browser cannot reserve space it does not know.
cards.fullLine: An image with no width or height causes layout shift.
